raw_generation:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER left=4.
NUMBER right=2.
LOOP (NUMBER i=3 TILL i>=0, i--) { IF (values[i]*values[i]>left) { left=values[i]*values[i]. }
}
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]>i) { right+=2. } }
DISPLAYNL(left+right).

task_metadata.prompt: Read four pipe-separated numbers. Find the last position that is entry whose square exceeds four. In a separate traversal count positions through it that are entry greater than its zero-based position; if no anchor exists count zero. Add 2.
